desc: Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

location: Chance to drop from Avionette Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm is the head slot of Avionette Soldier Set, at 3.8 weight. Look for it as a drop from Avionette Soldier.
whyItMatters: It gives 5 poise, and its best negation is against physical (4.4), then slash (4). Its two highest resistances are robustness at 18, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 11, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Avionette Soldier Set, the full set totals 12.6 weight and 19 poise. Budget 3.8 weight for the head slot.
name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm

desc: Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers. Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.
location: Chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies.
whatItIs: Blue Silver Mail Hood is the head slot piece, at 3.8 weight. Albinauric Archer can drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (4.4), then physical (4.2), and it adds 4 poise. For status effects, robustness (24) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (10) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 3.8 weight and want more slash negation.
name: Blue Silver Mail Hood

desc: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Blackflame Monks. The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.
location: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.
whatItIs: Blackflame Monk Hood is the head slot piece, at 4 weight. Dropped by Blackflame Monk.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (4.6), then physical (4.4), with 5 poise on top. The robustness value of 20 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 11 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Budget 4 weight for the head slot.
name: Blackflame Monk Hood

desc: Mask worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.
location: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Zamor Mask is a head piece from Zamor Set weighing 3.8. Ancient Hero of Zamor has to fall first before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (4.4), then physical (4.2), with 4 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 27, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 9, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Zamor Set, the full set totals 20.5 weight and 28 poise. Budget 3.8 weight for the head slot.
name: Zamor Mask

desc: Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.
location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.
whatItIs: Black Knife Hood is a head piece from Black Knife Set weighing 3.8. Corpse loot in Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: It gives 4 poise, and its best negation is against slash and pierce (4.2 each). For status effects, robustness (18) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (11) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Black Knife Set adds up to 21.8 weight and 29 poise. Budget 3.8 weight for the head slot.
name: Black Knife Hood

desc: Winged helm made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
whatItIs: Malenia's Winged Helm is a head piece from Malenia's Set weighing 4. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: It gives 4 poise, and its best negation is against slash (4.6), then physical (4.4). For status effects, immunity (22) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by robustness (18) against blood loss and frostbite.
whenToUse: As a full set, Malenia's Set adds up to 20.5 weight and 24 poise. Budget 4 weight for the head slot.
name: Malenia's Winged Helm

desc: Crown of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.
location: Sold by Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.
whatItIs: Elden Lord Crown is a head piece from Elden Lord Set weighing 3.6. Finger Reader Enia sells it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against pierce (4), then physical (3.8), and it adds 3 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 20, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 11, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Elden Lord Set adds up to 21.4 weight and 27 poise. At 3.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever pierce negation is what you are short on.
name: Elden Lord Crown

desc: Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.
location: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: Knight Helm is a head piece weighing 4.6. Sold by Twin Maiden Husks.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash and pierce (4.8 each), with 8 poise on top. In practice, the robustness value of 22 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 12 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Budget 4.6 weight for the head slot.
name: Knight Helm

desc: Helm of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. The visor is broken and can no longer be lowered. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.
location: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).
whatItIs: Vagabond Knight Helm is a head piece from Vagabond Knight Set weighing 4. The Vagabond class starts with it.
whyItMatters: It gives 4 poise, and its best negation is against physical (4.6), then slash (4.2). For status effects, robustness (23) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (14) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Vagabond Knight Set adds up to 23.8 weight and 30 poise. Budget 4 weight for the head slot.
name: Vagabond Knight Helm

desc: Sturdy greathelm made from iron. Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.
location: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).
whatItIs: Greathelm is a head piece weighing 5.9. Nomadic Merchant sells it in Caelid.
whyItMatters: It gives 7 poise, and its best negation is against slash (5.8), then physical (5.5). For status effects, robustness (29) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (16) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Check your equip load before adding its 5.9 weight to the head slot.
name: Greathelm

desc: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.
location: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.
whatItIs: Carian Knight Helm is a head piece from Carian Knight Set weighing 4.6. Its record carries a location note.
whyItMatters: It gives 4 poise, and its best negation is against slash and magic (4.4 each). The robustness value of 20 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 12 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Carian Knight Set comes to 25.1 weight and 26 poise, so plan your equip load around that. At 4.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Carian Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Adorned with a plume of withered, ashen hair.
location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.
whatItIs: Godrick Knight Helm is a head piece from Godrick Knight Set weighing 5.1. It drops from Godrick Knight.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (5), then physical (4.8), and it adds 6 poise. For status effects, robustness (24) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (15) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Godrick Knight Set comes to 28.1 weight and 40 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Godrick Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.
location: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.
whatItIs: Cuckoo Knight Set includes Cuckoo Knight Helm as its head piece, weight 5.1. It drops from Cuckoo Knight.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against slash (5.2), then physical (4.8). For status effects, robustness (24) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (14) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Cuckoo Knight Set, the full set totals 28.1 weight and 40 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Cuckoo Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son - the mane of the proud Red Lion.

whatItIs: Redmane Knight Helm is the head slot of Redmane Knight Set, at 5.1 weight. Dropped by Redmane Knight.

whenToUse: As a full set, Redmane Knight Set adds up to 28.1 weight and 40 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Redmane Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Its crest of red feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.
location: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.
whatItIs: Gelmir Knight Helm is the head slot of Gelmir Knight Set, at 5.1 weight.

whenToUse: The complete Gelmir Knight Set comes to 28.1 weight and 40 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Gelmir Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The golden canopy represents the honor of standing among the tree's defenders.

whenToUse: As a full set, Leyndell Knight Set adds up to 28.1 weight and 40 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Leyndell Knight Helm

desc: Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.
location: Found on a corpse up a ladder near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
whatItIs: Haligtree Knight Set includes Haligtree Knight Helm as its head piece, weight 5.1. A corpse at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree carries it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical and slash (4.8 each), and it adds 5 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 24, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 15, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Haligtree Knight Set adds up to 28.1 weight and 35 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Haligtree Knight Helm

desc: Metal helm with a pointed beak. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.
location: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight Set.
whatItIs: Bloodhound Knight Helm is the head slot of Bloodhound Knight Set, at 4.6 weight. Bloodhound Knight can drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (5), then pierce (4.8), and it adds 4 poise. The robustness value of 22 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 14 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Bloodhound Knight Set, the full set totals 25.3 weight and 29 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 4.6 weight and want more slash negation.
name: Bloodhound Knight Helm

desc: A helm worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. Vargram earned his nickname from the white wolf pelt that adorns this helm.
location: Obtained as part of Bernahl's Volcano Manor quest. You will have to defeat two NPCs in a scripted invasion together with Bernahl in the Fortified Manor, Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Raging Wolf Helm is the head slot of Raging Wolf Set, at 4.6 weight. Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical and slash (4.8 each), with 5 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 24, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 14, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Raging Wolf Set, the full set totals 25.3 weight and 32 poise. Budget 4.6 weight for the head slot.
name: Raging Wolf Helm

desc: A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the revered House of Hoslow. Juno Hoslow had a younger brother who was all talk and no trousers. His inability to commit to action was such that Juno inherited the Hoslow legacy without resistance, granting him the freedom to shower his little brother with adoration.
location: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.
whatItIs: Hoslow's Set includes Hoslow's Helm as its head piece, weight 5.5. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against physical (5.2), then slash (5). The robustness value of 27 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 18 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Hoslow's Set adds up to 28.5 weight and 36 poise. Budget 5.5 weight for the head slot.
name: Hoslow's Helm

desc: Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails. Diallos Hoslow had an older brother who was a stern, self-possessed man of few words. His achievements made him seem out of reach. And so the younger aspired to be like the older. Yearning for the day that he would tell the tale of House Hoslow, in blood. Knowing full well that it would break his brother's heart.
location: Obtained from Knight Diallos after completing his questline, or by killing him.
whatItIs: Diallos's Set includes Diallos's Mask as its head piece, weight 4.6. Knight Diallos hands it over.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical (4.8), then slash (4.6), and it adds 7 poise. For status effects, robustness (23) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (15) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Diallos's Set adds up to 27.6 weight and 37 poise. At 4.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Diallos's Mask

desc: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver. The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another. Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.
location: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.
whatItIs: Twinned Helm is the head slot of Twinned Set, at 5.1 weight. D, Hunter of the Dead has to fall first before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (5.2), then physical (4.8), with 5 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 23, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and vitality at 23, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Twinned Set adds up to 30 weight and 40 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the head slot.
name: Twinned Helm

desc: Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.
location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.
whatItIs: Drake Knight Helm is a head piece from Drake Knight Set weighing 4. An altered form of this piece exists. Chest loot in Crumbling Farum Azula.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (4.2), then physical (4), and it adds 4 poise. In practice, its two highest resistances are robustness at 20, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 11, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Drake Knight Set comes to 22 weight and 29 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 4 weight for the head slot.
name: Drake Knight Helm

desc: Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?
location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Fingerprint Helm is the head slot of Fingerprint Set, at 4.6 weight. Beat Roundtable Knight Vyke for it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical (4.8), then fire (4.5), and it adds 6 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 26, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 14, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Fingerprint Set comes to 25.3 weight and 40 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 4.6 weight for the head slot.
name: Fingerprint Helm

desc: Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing. Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced. It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.
location: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).
whatItIs: Royal Remains Set includes Royal Remains Helm as its head piece, weight 4.6. Beat Ensha of the Royal Remains in Roundtable Hold to get it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (4.6), then physical (4.2), and it adds 5 poise. In practice, for status effects, robustness (24) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (15) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Royal Remains Set, the full set totals 25.3 weight and 32 poise. Budget 4.6 weight for the head slot.
name: Royal Remains Helm

desc: Helm set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.
location: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon defeat.
whatItIs: All-Knowing Set includes All-Knowing Helm as its head piece, weight 4.6. Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.
whyItMatters: It gives 5 poise, and its best negation is against slash (4.8), then physical (4.6). For status effects, robustness (20) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (12) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete All-Knowing Set comes to 25.4 weight and 42 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 4.6 weight for the head slot.
name: All-Knowing Helm

desc: Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
whatItIs: Royal Knight Helm is a head piece from Royal Knight Set weighing 6.6. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (6.3), then pierce (6.1), with 8 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 29, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 22, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Royal Knight Set adds up to 36.9 weight and 51 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 6.6 weight to the head slot.
name: Royal Knight Helm

desc: Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
whatItIs: Maliketh's Helm is a head piece from Maliketh's Set weighing 5.5. Finger Reader Enia sells it.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against slash (5), then physical (4.8). The robustness value of 24 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the vitality value of 22 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Maliketh's Set, the full set totals 30.5 weight and 40 poise. At 5.5 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Maliketh's Helm

desc: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.
location: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.
whatItIs: Banished Knight Helm is the head slot of Banished Knight Set, at 7.5 weight. This piece can be altered. Dropped by Banished Knight.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (7), then physical (6.8), and it adds 9 poise. For status effects, robustness (35) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (26) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Banished Knight Set adds up to 41.6 weight and 60 poise. Budget 7.5 weight for the head slot.
name: Banished Knight Helm

desc: An old helm that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master. This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.
whatItIs: Veteran's Helm is a head piece from Veteran's Set weighing 8.1.
whyItMatters: It gives 12 poise, and its best negation is against physical and slash (6.8 each). For status effects, robustness (39) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (27) against poison and scarlet rot.

name: Veteran's Helm

desc: Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone.
location: Received upon: Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.
whatItIs: Beast Champion Helm is a head piece, weight 7.5. The record places it in Crumbling Farum Azula.

whenToUse: At 7.5 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Beast Champion Helm

location: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Tree Sentinel Helm is a head piece from Tree Sentinel Set weighing 8.1. The record places it in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical and slash (6.8 each), and it adds 9 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 39, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 29, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.

name: Tree Sentinel Helm

desc: A malformed golden helm. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.
location: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
whatItIs: Malformed Dragon Helm is the head slot of Malformed Dragon Set, at 6.8 weight. Beat Draconic Tree Sentinel in Crumbling Farum Azula to get it.
