name: Malformed Dragon Helm

desc: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.
location: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Crucible Axe Helm is a head piece from Crucible Axe Set weighing 6.6. Beat Crucible Knight Ordovis for it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (6.3), then slash (6.1), with 9 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 31, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 22, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Crucible Axe Set comes to 36.9 weight and 58 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 6.6 weight for the head slot.
name: Crucible Axe Helm

desc: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.
location: The Crucible Tree Helm is found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths.
whatItIs: Crucible Tree Helm is a head piece from Crucible Tree Set weighing 6.6. A chest in Deeproot Depths holds it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (6.5), then slash (6.3), with 9 poise on top. The robustness value of 31 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 22 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Crucible Tree Set adds up to 36.9 weight and 58 poise. At 6.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Crucible Tree Helm

desc: Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn. Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications. "I was born a champion's cub. Now I am the Lord of the Battlefield's lion."
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.
whatItIs: Radahn's Redmane Helm is a head piece from Radahn's Set weighing 7.5. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (6.8), then slash (6.7), with 9 poise on top. The robustness value of 42 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 26 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Radahn's Set adds up to 41.6 weight and 60 poise. At 7.5 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Radahn's Redmane Helm

desc: Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted. When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.
location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Lionel's Helm is the head slot of Lionel's Set, at 9.1 weight. A corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital carries it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against pierce (7.2), then slash (7), and it adds 12 poise. The robustness value of 42 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 27 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Lionel's Set, the full set totals 50.5 weight and 79 poise. At 9.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever pierce negation is what you are short on.
name: Lionel's Helm

desc: Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise. Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.
location: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.
whatItIs: Bull-Goat Helm is a head piece from Bull-Goat Set weighing 11.3. Beat Great Horned Tragoth to get it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (7.5), then strike (7.4), with 15 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 35, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 31, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Bull-Goat Set, the full set totals 63 weight and 100 poise. At 11.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Bull-Goat Helm

desc: Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off. Worn by the Dung Eater, its form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it. The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence? What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all.
location: Received at the end of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.
whatItIs: Omen Helm is the head slot of Omen Set, at 9.9 weight.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash and pierce (6.8 each), and it adds 13 poise. The vitality value of 33 helps against death blight, and the immunity value of 29 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Omen Set adds up to 55 weight and 86 poise. Budget 9.9 weight for the head slot.
name: Omen Helm

desc: Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks. It is said the cauldron perched atop the head was originally furnished with embers, and would surge into flames when the wearer's faith reached its zenith. The fire of this cauldron has since died out, however.
location: Chance to drop from Fire Prelates.
whatItIs: Fire Prelate Set includes Fire Prelate Helm as its head piece, weight 10.6. Fire Prelates can drop it.
whyItMatters: It gives 13 poise, and its best negation is against fire (7.2), then physical (7). For status effects, focus (39) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by immunity (29) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Fire Prelate Set adds up to 58.8 weight and 87 poise. At 10.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever fire negation is what you are short on.
name: Fire Prelate Helm

desc: An oval helm large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard. Reduces damage from headshots and impacts. The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.
location: Chance to drop from Mad Pumpkin Head enemies.
whatItIs: Pumpkin Helm is a head piece weighing 12.3. Dropped by Mad Pumpkin.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (7), then slash (6.7), with 9 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are focus at 44, which helps against sleep and madness, and robustness at 42, which helps against blood loss and frostbite.
whenToUse: Budget 12.3 weight for the head slot.
name: Pumpkin Helm

desc: Light yet sturdy clothes. Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.
location: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.
whatItIs: Traveler's Set includes Traveler's Clothes as its chest piece, weight 4.1. The location note is on its record.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13.3), then lightning (12.8), and it adds 2 poise. The focus value of 67 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 67 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Traveler's Set comes to 8.9 weight and 4 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 4.1 weight to the chest slot.
name: Traveler's Clothes

desc: Garb with a modest cloth cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.
location: Found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle.
whatItIs: Commoner's Simple Garb is a chest piece, weight 5.1. This piece can be altered. A corpse carries it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic (13), then holy (12.8), with 2 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 83, which helps against death blight, and focus at 76, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: At 5.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Commoner's Simple Garb

desc: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.
location: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.
whatItIs: Commoner's Garb is the chest slot of Commoner's Set, at 5.1 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. An enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.8 each), and it adds 2 poise. The vitality value of 83 helps against death blight, and the focus value of 76 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Commoner's Set adds up to 8.5 weight and 3 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Commoner's Garb

desc: High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.
location: Chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it, such as the Sorcerer type. Two Sorcerer Wandering Nobles can be found to the east and north of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Aristocrat Garb is the chest slot of Aristocrat Set, at 4.9 weight. This piece can be altered. Wandering Nobles can drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against strike (8.6), then physical (7.8), with 2 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 47, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 36, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Aristocrat Set, the full set totals 9 weight and 3 poise. At 4.9 weight it is worth slotting in whenever strike negation is what you are short on.
name: Aristocrat Garb

desc: Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belongings of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.
location: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two immediately north of the Mistwood Ouksirts Sites of Grace, following a torch bearer.
whatItIs: Aristocrat of Knightly Descent Set includes Aristocrat Coat as its chest piece, weight 7.1. Look for it as a drop from Wandering Noble.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against fire (11.4), then magic (10.9), with 3 poise on top. The immunity value of 50 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the vitality value of 46 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Aristocrat of Knightly Descent Set, the full set totals 10.1 weight and 4 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 7.1 weight and want more fire negation.
name: Aristocrat Coat

desc: Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.
location: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow...
whatItIs: Old Aristocrat Gown is the chest slot of Old Aristocrat Set, at 5.1 weight. It drops from Wandering Noble.
whyItMatters: It gives 2 poise, and its best negation is against fire (10.2), then magic (9.5). For status effects, immunity (42) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by vitality (38) against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Old Aristocrat Set comes to 9.3 weight and 4 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 5.1 weight to the chest slot.
name: Old Aristocrat Gown

desc: Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.
location: Chance to drop from Page enemies.
whatItIs: Page Garb is a chest piece from Page Set weighing 5.1. This piece can be altered. Dropped by Page.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against lightning and holy (13 each), and it adds 2 poise. The focus value of 83 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 83 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Page Set, the full set totals 9 weight and 3 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Page Garb

desc: Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve. Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.
location: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: High Page Clothes is a chest piece from High Page Set weighing 5.3. This piece can be altered. High Page in Leyndell, Royal Capital can drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13.5), then holy (13.2), and it adds 2 poise. Its two highest resistances are focus at 76, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 76, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete High Page Set comes to 9.2 weight and 3 poise, so plan your equip load around that. At 5.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: High Page Clothes

desc: Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees. In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.
location: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it. Cannot be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Guardian Garb is the chest slot piece, at 7.7 weight. Erdtree Guardian can drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic and lightning (10.9 each), with 4 poise on top. For status effects, immunity (61) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (50) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: At 7.7 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Guardian Garb

desc: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Faintly bloodstained.
location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be altered by yourself or by Boc.
whatItIs: Festive Set includes Festive Garb as its chest piece, weight 4.1. This piece can be altered. Enemies in Altus Plateau drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against holy (13), then magic (12.6), with 1 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are focus at 67, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 67, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Festive Set comes to 5.8 weight and 1 poise, so plan your equip load around that. At 4.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever holy negation is what you are short on.
name: Festive Garb

desc: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.
location: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Blue Festive Garb is a chest piece weighing 4.1. Enemies in Altus Plateau drop it.
whyItMatters: It gives 1 poise, and its best negation is against holy (13.8), then magic (12.6). Its two highest resistances are focus at 71, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 63, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Blue Festive Garb

desc: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.
location: Starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).
whatItIs: Prisoner Clothing is a chest piece from Prisoner Set weighing 3.2. The Prisoner class starts with it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against holy (12.6), then magic (11.9), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, focus (63) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (63) against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Prisoner Set adds up to 13.8 weight and 13 poise. At 3.2 weight it is worth slotting in whenever holy negation is what you are short on.
name: Prisoner Clothing

desc: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the torso. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.
location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Mushroom Body is a chest piece weighing 5.1. Corpse loot in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13.3), then holy (13), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, immunity (102) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (90) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Mushroom Body

desc: Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
location: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).
whatItIs: Astrologer Robe is a chest piece from Astrologer Set weighing 6.3. This piece can be altered. It is Astrologer starting gear.
whyItMatters: It gives 5 poise, and its best negation is against magic (13.5), then lightning (13.3). Its two highest resistances are focus at 90, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 76, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Astrologer Set adds up to 13.3 weight and 10 poise. At 6.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Astrologer Robe

desc: Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.
location: Requires having seen the "Resurrection" Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. The location depicted in the painting can be found south east of the Behind Caria Manor site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. The set will be dropped on the ground once reaching destination.
whatItIs: Juvenile Scholar Robe is a chest piece weighing 4.1. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (12.8), then holy (12.6), and it adds 7 poise. For status effects, vitality (71) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (63) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Juvenile Scholar Robe

desc: Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity. But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.
location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.
whatItIs: Raya Lucarian Robe is a chest piece from Raya Lucaria Set weighing 4.1. Look for it as a drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13.5), then holy (12.8), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, focus (67) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (63) against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Raya Lucaria Set adds up to 12.3 weight and 5 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 4.1 weight and want more magic negation.
name: Raya Lucarian Robe

desc: Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy. Theses scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.
location: Chance to drop from Lazuli Sorcerer enemies that wear it.
whatItIs: Lazuli Robe is the chest slot of Lazuli Sorcerer Set, at 4.1 weight. Dropped by Lazuli Sorcerer.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13.8), then holy (12.8), and it adds 2 poise. For status effects, focus (67) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (67) against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Lazuli Sorcerer Set comes to 12.3 weight and 6 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Lazuli Robe

desc: Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy scholar, tattered from being worn on the battlefied. Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside. Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape.
location: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.
whatItIs: Battlemage Robe is a chest piece from Battlemage Set weighing 4.1. An enemy drop in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic (13), then holy (12.6), with 2 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 71, which helps against death blight, and focus at 63, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Battlemage Set comes to 10.4 weight and 10 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Battlemage Robe

desc: Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.
location: Found altered on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir. Can be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Errant Sorcerer Robe is the chest slot of Errant Sorcerer Set, at 4.1 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. A corpse in Mt. Gelmir carries it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (13 each), and it adds 2 poise. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 71, which helps against death blight, and focus at 67, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Errant Sorcerer Set adds up to 11.3 weight and 5 poise. At 4.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Errant Sorcerer Robe

desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills. Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.
location: Complete Rogier's questline.
whatItIs: Spellblade's Traveling Attire is the chest slot of Spellblade's Set, at 3.3 weight. This piece can be altered.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.7 each), and it adds 1 poise. The vitality value of 63 helps against death blight, and the focus value of 59 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Spellblade's Set adds up to 8.6 weight and 2 poise. Budget 3.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire

desc: Mad Tongue Alberich's robe. Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthen thorn sorcery. Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.
location: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Alberich's Robe is a chest piece from Alberich's Set weighing 4.1. An altered form of this piece exists. Look for it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.8 each), and it adds 7 poise. For status effects, vitality (71) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (67) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Alberich's Set, the full set totals 9.7 weight and 8 poise. Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Alberich's Robe

desc: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendant of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.
location: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Preceptor's Long Gown is the chest slot piece, at 6.3 weight. This piece can be altered. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (14.5), then fire (13.3), and it adds 3 poise. Its two highest resistances are focus at 83, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 76, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Budget 6.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Preceptor's Long Gown

desc: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue-green glintstones. Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.
location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.
whatItIs: Azur's Glintstone Set includes Azur's Glintstone Robe as its chest piece, weight 7.1. Look for it in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It gives 3 poise, and its best negation is against magic (15.4), then holy (13.8). Its two highest resistances are focus at 99, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 83, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Azur's Glintstone Set, the full set totals 14.3 weight and 6 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 7.1 weight to the chest slot.
name: Azur's Glintstone Robe

desc: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones. Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.
location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.
whatItIs: Lusat's Set includes Lusat's Robe as its chest piece, weight 7.1. Its record carries a location note.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic (15.4), then holy (13.5), with 3 poise on top. For status effects, vitality (99) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (83) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Lusat's Set, the full set totals 14.3 weight and 6 poise. At 7.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Lusat's Robe

desc: Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
whatItIs: Queen's Robe is the chest slot of Queen's Set, at 5.1 weight. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic (13.8), then holy (13.3), with 2 poise on top. For status effects, vitality (83) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (71) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Queen's Set, the full set totals 11 weight and 4 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Queen's Robe

desc: Witch's robe in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.
location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.
whatItIs: Snow Witch Robe is the chest slot of Snow Witch Set, at 5.5 weight. This piece can be altered. A chest at Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes holds it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic and fire (13.4 each), with 2 poise on top. For status effects, focus (71) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (71) against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Snow Witch Set adds up to 10.8 weight and 4 poise. Budget 5.5 weight for the chest slot.
name: Snow Witch Robe

desc: Robe of black cloth that covers the enitre body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home. The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.
location: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother.
whatItIs: Fia's Robe is the chest slot of Fia's Set, at 5.1 weight. This piece can be altered. Fia can drop it.
whyItMatters: It gives 2 poise, and its best negation is against holy (13), then magic (12.6). The vitality value of 108 helps against death blight, and the focus value of 76 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Fia's Set comes to 6.8 weight and 2 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 5.1 weight and want more holy negation.
name: Fia's Robe

desc: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while stil sharing her warmth.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace. WARNING: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, Leyndell, Royal Capital will turn to Leyndell, Ashen Capital, and the dress, along with every item in Leyndell, Royal Capital, will...
whatItIs: Deathbed Dress is the chest slot piece, at 3.2 weight. Corpse loot in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against holy (12.4), then magic (11.9), and it adds 5 poise. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 107, which helps against death blight, and focus at 63, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 3.2 weight and want more holy negation.
name: Deathbed Dress

desc: Robe of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. The shackles around the neck warn passersby not to lend an ear to their sermons.
location: Starting gear for the Prophet class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).
whatItIs: Prophet Robe is a chest piece from Prophet Set weighing 6.3. An altered form of this piece exists. Starting gear for the Prophet.
whyItMatters: It gives 3 poise, and its best negation is against magic (13.5), then lightning (13). For status effects, vitality (90) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (83) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Prophet Set adds up to 10.4 weight and 4 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 6.3 weight and want more magic negation.
name: Prophet Robe

desc: Robe worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.
location: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Traveling Maiden Robe is a chest piece weighing 4.9. This piece can be altered. Looted from a corpse at Shack of the Lofty.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (13.4 each), and it adds 2 poise. For status effects, vitality (83) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (76) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: At 4.9 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Traveling Maiden Robe

desc: Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.
location: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Finger Maiden Robe is the chest slot piece, at 4.6 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. A corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes carries it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic and holy (13.8 each), with 2 poise on top. The focus value of 63 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 63 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 4.6 weight and want more magic negation.
name: Finger Maiden Robe

desc: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excesses of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?
location: Complete Goldmask's questline, then reload the area to loot the armor set from where you found him.
whatItIs: Goldmask's Rags is a chest piece from Goldmask's Set weighing 2.4. The location note is on its record.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against holy (12.8), then magic (11.9), with 1 poise on top. For status effects, focus (60) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (60) against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Goldmask's Set, the full set totals 9.8 weight and 10 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 2.4 weight to the chest slot.
name: Goldmask's Rags

desc: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer. The thick front apron ambroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.
location: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.
whatItIs: Perfumer Robe is a chest piece from Perfumer's Set weighing 5.1. An altered form of this piece exists. Look for it as a drop from Perfumer.
whyItMatters: It gives 2 poise, and its best negation is against magic and holy (13 each). Its two highest resistances are vitality at 76, which helps against death blight, and focus at 71, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Perfumer's Set adds up to 10.7 weight and 4 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Perfumer Robe

desc: Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.
location: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.
whatItIs: Depraved Perfumer Robe is the chest slot of Depraved Perfumer Set, at 5 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. It drops from Depraved Perfumer.
whyItMatters: It gives 2 poise, and its best negation is against magic (13.2), then fire (12.7). For status effects, vitality (80) leads, helping against death blight, followed by immunity (65) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Depraved Perfumer Set comes to 13.4 weight and 6 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 5 weight to the chest slot.
name: Depraved Perfumer Robe

desc: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.
location: Bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau Found on a corpse on a balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital
whatItIs: Upper-Class Robe is a chest piece, weight 4.1. It is for sale from Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against holy (13), then magic (12.8), and it adds 1 poise. Its two highest resistances are focus at 61, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 61, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 4.1 weight and want more holy negation.
name: Upper-Class Robe

desc: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.
location: Found on a corpse on a broken caravan near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Ruler's Robe is a chest piece from Ruler's Set weighing 5.1. Corpse loot in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against holy (13.3), then magic (13), with 2 poise on top. For status effects, focus (76) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (76) against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Ruler's Set, the full set totals 7.3 weight and 3 poise. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Ruler's Robe

desc: Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor. Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort. She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy. In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.
location: Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline.
whatItIs: Consort's Robe is a chest piece weighing 4.1. Enemies drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13), then holy (12.8), and it adds 7 poise. The focus value of 67 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 63 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Consort's Robe

desc: Grubby blue robe worn by magisterial officials to carry out their grim tasks. Surveillance, execution, gruesome rituals... The darkest duties drive the wheels of mankind.
location: Hidden within a room that you can only reach from the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace.
whatItIs: Official's Attire is the chest slot of Bloodsoaked Set, at 4.1 weight.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.8 each), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, vitality (64) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (61) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Bloodsoaked Set adds up to 7.7 weight and 1 poise. Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Official's Attire

desc: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce godess who was born into rot.
location: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.
whatItIs: Marais Robe is the chest slot piece, at 4.1 weight. Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan can drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.6 each), and it adds 2 poise. The focus value of 71 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 67 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Marais Robe

desc: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans. The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.
location: Shaman Furs have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.
whatItIs: Shaman Furs is the chest slot piece, at 5.1 weight. Look for it as a drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans (a 1.5% chance).
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against pierce and magic (8 each), and it adds 2 poise. The immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the focus value of 55 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 5.1 weight and want more pierce negation.
name: Shaman Furs

desc: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Worn by the Godskin Apostles. The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.
location: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.
whatItIs: Godskin Apostle Robe is the chest slot of Godskin Apostle Set, at 4.1 weight. Beat Godskin Apostle in Caelid to get it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against holy (13.8), then magic (12.6), with 2 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are focus at 67, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 63, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Godskin Apostle Set, the full set totals 10.9 weight and 5 poise. Budget 4.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Godskin Apostle Robe

desc: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles, known for their seven-face aprons. Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.
location: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.
whatItIs: Godskin Noble Robe is a chest piece from Godskin Noble Set weighing 6.3. Beat Godskin Noble for it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against holy (14.1), then magic (13), with 5 poise on top. In practice, for status effects, vitality (83) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (76) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Godskin Noble Set comes to 12.2 weight and 8 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 6.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Godskin Noble Robe

desc: A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed of Margit, the Fell Omen. Having slaughtered countless champions during the Shattering, the Fell Omen has become a horror to those who harbor ambitions for the Erdtree, or for Lordship.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Morgott, the Omen King.
whatItIs: Fell Omen Cloak is a chest piece weighing 5.1. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (13), then holy (12.8), and it adds 8 poise. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 83, which helps against death blight, and focus at 71, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Fell Omen Cloak

desc: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.
location: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees north west of Consecrated Snowfield.
whatItIs: Sanguine Noble Robe is the chest slot of Sanguine Noble Set, at 5.1 weight. Beat Sanguine Noble for it.
whyItMatters: It gives 2 poise, and its best negation is against holy (13.5), then magic (13.3). For status effects, focus (83) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (76) against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Sanguine Noble Set comes to 9 weight and 3 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 5.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Sanguine Noble Robe

desc: Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.
location: Drops from Patches.
whatItIs: Leather Set includes Leather Armor as its chest piece, weight 7.1. Dropped by Patches.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against lightning and holy (10.2 each), and it adds 2 poise. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 60, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and vitality at 50, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Leather Set comes to 16.6 weight and 5 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 7.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Leather Armor

desc: Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.
location: Starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).
whatItIs: Blue Cloth Vest is the chest slot of Blue Cloth Set, at 7.7 weight. The Warrior class starts with it.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against lightning (11.9), then fire (10.9). Its two highest resistances are immunity at 63, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 50, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Blue Cloth Set comes to 17.8 weight and 12 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 7.7 weight and want more lightning negation.
name: Blue Cloth Vest

desc: Travelling attire fashioned from metallic white silk thread. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.
location: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Noble's Traveling Set includes Noble's Traveling Garb as its chest piece, weight 6.3. Altus Plateau is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against fire (13.5), then magic (13.3), with 2 poise on top. In practice, the vitality value of 83 helps against death blight, and the focus value of 76 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Noble's Traveling Set adds up to 14 weight and 7 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 6.3 weight to the chest slot.
name: Noble's Traveling Garb

desc: Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.
location: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace.
whatItIs: War Surgeon Gown is the chest slot of War Surgeon Set, at 6.9 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. It drops from Nameless White Mask in Mohgwyn Palace.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (10.8), then fire (10.1), with 13 poise on top. For status effects, immunity (53) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by vitality (48) against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete War Surgeon Set comes to 16.6 weight and 29 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 6.9 weight to the chest slot.
name: War Surgeon Gown

desc: Finery of the nomadic merchants. Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors. These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground. Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.
location: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.
whatItIs: Nomadic Merchant's Finery is a chest piece, weight 7.2. This piece can be altered. Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: It gives 3 poise, and its best negation is against magic and fire (9.5 each). The focus value of 71 helps against sleep and madness, and the immunity value of 57 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: At 7.2 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery

desc: Leather garb worn by bandits. Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In trade, they offer little damage negation.
location: Origin: Starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,500 Runes.
whatItIs: Bandit Set includes Bandit Garb as its chest piece, weight 7.7. The Bandit class starts with it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (10.9), then magic (10.2), with 15 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are focus at 54, which helps against sleep and madness, and vitality at 54, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Bandit Set adds up to 16.8 weight and 29 poise. Budget 7.7 weight for the chest slot.
name: Bandit Garb

desc: Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.
location: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).
whatItIs: Confessor Armor is a chest piece from Confessor Set weighing 8.3. This piece can be altered. It is Confessor starting gear.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against lightning (12.4), then magic (11.4). The immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the vitality value of 55 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Confessor Set comes to 19.2 weight and 12 poise, so plan your equip load around that. At 8.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever lightning negation is what you are short on.
name: Confessor Armor

desc: Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience. Its thick apron is worn in rememberance of Rollo, the progenitor of the Omenkillers and a perfumer of antiquity.
location: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Omenkiller Set includes Omenkiller Robe as its chest piece, weight 7.1. Look for it in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against lightning (11.4), then holy (10.2), and it adds 6 poise. The immunity value of 67 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the focus value of 46 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Omenkiller Set comes to 16.9 weight and 17 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 7.1 weight and want more lightning negation.
name: Omenkiller Robe

desc: Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassins of Ravenmount. A ritual implement for transforming into a Deathbird, if only by imitation. Strengthens jump attacks. "We are birds of prey, bringers of death."
location: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave.
whatItIs: Raptor's Black Feathers is a chest piece weighing 7.7. Found in a chest at Sage's Cave.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against lightning (10.9), then magic (10.2), and it adds 15 poise. The focus value of 60 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 60 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Check your equip load before adding its 7.7 weight to the chest slot.
name: Raptor's Black Feathers

desc: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.
location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Foot Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Foot Soldier Tabard is a chest piece, weight 8.3. Dropped by Raya Lucarian Foot Soldier.
whyItMatters: It gives 8 poise, and its best negation is against magic and fire (11.4 each). In practice, for status effects, immunity (63) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (55) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 8.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Foot Soldier Tabard

desc: Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl drapped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.
location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Leather-Draped Tabard is a chest piece, weight 8.3. Look for it as a drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (12.4), then strike (10.9), with 8 poise on top. In practice, the immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the focus value of 55 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 8.3 weight and want more lightning negation.
name: Leather-Draped Tabard

desc: Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.
location: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.
whatItIs: Chain-Draped Tabard is the chest slot piece, at 8.3 weight. Godrick Foot Soldier can drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (11.9), then fire (11.4), with 8 poise on top. In practice, its two highest resistances are immunity at 63, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 55, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 8.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Chain-Draped Tabard

desc: Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.
location: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Ivory-Draped Tabard is the chest slot piece, at 8.3 weight. It drops from Haligtree Foot Soldier.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against lightning (11.9), then holy (11.4), and it adds 6 poise. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 63, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and vitality at 57, which helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Budget 8.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Ivory-Draped Tabard

desc: Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot. Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army.
location: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Scarlet Tabard is a chest piece, weight 8.3. It drops from Radahn Foot Soldier.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against fire and lightning (11.9 each), and it adds 8 poise. For a new player, for status effects, immunity (63) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (55) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: At 8.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever fire negation is what you are short on.
name: Scarlet Tabard

desc: Padded cloth armor with indelible bloostains around the neck. Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
location: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: Bloodsoaked Tabard is the chest slot piece, at 8.3 weight. Look for it as a drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (12.4), then holy (11.4), with 9 poise on top. For a new player, its two highest resistances are immunity at 63, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 55, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 8.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Bloodsoaked Tabard

desc: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.
location: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.
whatItIs: Highwayman Cloth Armor is a chest piece, weight 7.7. It drops from Highwayman in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It gives 6 poise, and its best negation is against lightning (11.4), then magic (10.9). For status effects, immunity (57) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (50) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 7.7 weight for the chest slot.
name: Highwayman Cloth Armor

desc: Thick, bristly cloak that is the symbol of an underground gravekeeper. Those who once fought for a living were driven from the colosseum, and becoming guardians of Erdtree Burial.
location: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.
whatItIs: Gravekeeper Cloak is the chest slot of Duelist Set, at 6.3 weight. This piece can be altered. Dropped by Duelist-type.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (10.2), then fire (9.5), with 2 poise on top. For status effects, immunity (63) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (42) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Duelist Set, the full set totals 19.8 weight and 21 poise. Budget 6.3 weight for the chest slot.
name: Gravekeeper Cloak

desc: Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot. The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.
location: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.
whatItIs: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak is a chest piece from Rotten Duelist Set weighing 6.3. This piece can be altered. Putrid Grave Warden Duelist in Consecrated Snowfield can drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (10.9), then magic (8.8), with 2 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 76, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 43, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Rotten Duelist Set adds up to 20 weight and 20 poise. At 6.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever lightning negation is what you are short on.
name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak

desc: Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.
location: Chance to drop from Nox Monk enemies.
whatItIs: Nox Monk Armor is the chest slot piece, at 8.1 weight. This piece can be altered. Dropped by Nox Monk.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (12.2), then fire (11.7), and it adds 6 poise. The immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the focus value of 50 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 8.1 weight for the chest slot.
name: Nox Monk Armor

desc: Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.
location: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.
whatItIs: Night Maiden Armor is a chest piece weighing 8.3. Night Maiden can drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (12.4 each), and it adds 6 poise. For a new player, the immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the focus value of 55 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: At 8.3 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Night Maiden Armor

desc: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.
location: Starting gear for the Hero class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).
whatItIs: Champion Set includes Champion Pauldron as its chest piece, weight 5.1. It is Hero starting gear.

location: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants.
