whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical (14), then slash (13.5), and it adds 16 poise. The robustness value of 60 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 38 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Hoslow's Set, the full set totals 28.5 weight and 36 poise. Budget 11.8 weight for the chest slot.
name: Hoslow's Armor

desc: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.
location: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.
whatItIs: Drake Knight Set includes Drake Knight Armor as its chest piece, weight 9.2. This piece can be altered. Found in a chest in Crumbling Farum Azula.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (11.9), then physical (11.4), with 14 poise on top. The robustness value of 46 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 25 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Drake Knight Set adds up to 22 weight and 29 poise. Budget 9.2 weight for the chest slot.
name: Drake Knight Armor

desc: Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar. The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls. Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.
whatItIs: Briar Armor is the chest slot of Briar Set, at 11.8 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. Finger Reader Enia sells it for 6,000 runes in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (13.5), then physical (12.9), with 14 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 71, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 35, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Briar Set comes to 28.1 weight and 31 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 11.8 weight for the chest slot.
name: Briar Armor

desc: Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?
location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Fingerprint Set includes Fingerprint Armor as its chest piece, weight 10.6. This piece can be altered. Beat Roundtable Knight Vyke in Mountaintops of the Giants to get it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (13.5), then fire (12.6), with 19 poise on top. For status effects, robustness (60) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (32) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Fingerprint Set adds up to 25.3 weight and 40 poise. Budget 10.6 weight for the chest slot.
name: Fingerprint Armor

desc: Armor graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing. Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced. It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.
location: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).
whatItIs: Royal Remains Armor is a chest piece from Royal Remains Set weighing 10.6. It comes from beating Ensha of the Royal Remains in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (12.9), then physical (11.9), with 15 poise on top. In practice, the robustness value of 57 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 35 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Royal Remains Set comes to 25.3 weight and 32 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 10.6 weight for the chest slot.
name: Royal Remains Armor

desc: Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.
location: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
whatItIs: Maliketh's Set includes Maliketh's Armor as its chest piece, weight 12.8. An altered form of this piece exists. It is for sale from Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (14), then physical (13.5), with 19 poise on top. The robustness value of 57 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the vitality value of 50 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Maliketh's Set comes to 30.5 weight and 40 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 12.8 weight and want more slash negation.
name: Maliketh's Armor

desc: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.
location: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one accompanied by two wolves in Castle Sol.
whatItIs: Banished Knight Set includes Banished Knight Armor as its chest piece, weight 17.5. An altered form of this piece exists. It drops from Banished Knight.
whyItMatters: It gives 28 poise, and its best negation is against slash (19.2), then physical (18.7). For status effects, robustness (83) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (60) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Banished Knight Set comes to 41.6 weight and 60 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 17.5 weight to the chest slot.
name: Banished Knight Armor

desc: Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.
location: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.
whatItIs: Night's Cavalry Armor is a chest piece from Night's Cavalry Set weighing 12.8. This piece can be altered. Night's Cavalry has to fall first in Consecrated Snowfield before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: It gives 21 poise, and its best negation is against physical and slash (14 each). Its two highest resistances are robustness at 57, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 38, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Night's Cavalry Set comes to 30.5 weight and 44 poise, so plan your equip load around that. At 12.8 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Night's Cavalry Armor

desc: Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master. This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.
whatItIs: Veteran's Armor is a chest piece from Veteran's Set weighing 18.9. An altered form of this piece exists. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: It gives 37 poise, and its best negation is against physical and slash (18.7 each). The robustness value of 90 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 63 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Veteran's Set adds up to 45 weight and 79 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 18.9 weight and want more physical negation.
name: Veteran's Armor

desc: Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.
location: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.
whatItIs: Scaled Armor is a chest piece weighing 16. This piece can be altered. Beat Old Knight Istvan for it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (16.8), then physical (16), and it adds 27 poise. The robustness value of 83 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 57 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Budget 16 weight for the chest slot.
name: Scaled Armor

desc: Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.
location: Altered version is received upon: Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard. Needs to be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Beast Champion Armor is the chest slot piece, at 17.5 weight. This piece can be altered. Its location note points to Crumbling Farum Azula.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (18.7), then pierce (18.3), with 28 poise on top. The robustness value of 90 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 57 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Budget 17.5 weight for the chest slot.
name: Beast Champion Armor

desc: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree. Adorned with a cape featuring the mark of the sacred tree. Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.
location: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Tree Sentinel Armor is the chest slot of Tree Sentinel Set, at 18.9 weight. An altered form of this piece exists. The record places it in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: It gives 28 poise, and its best negation is against physical and slash (18.7 each). Its two highest resistances are robustness at 90, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 67, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Tree Sentinel Set comes to 45 weight and 60 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 18.9 weight for the chest slot.
name: Tree Sentinel Armor

desc: Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.
location: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
whatItIs: Malformed Dragon Set includes Malformed Dragon Armor as its chest piece, weight 16. Draconic Tree Sentinel has to fall first in Crumbling Farum Azula before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (17.5), then physical (16.8), and it adds 26 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 76, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 57, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Malformed Dragon Set, the full set totals 38 weight and 56 poise. At 16 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Malformed Dragon Armor

desc: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.
location: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Crucible Axe Armor is a chest piece from Crucible Axe Set weighing 15.5. An altered form of this piece exists. Crucible Knight Ordovis has to fall first in Altus Plateau before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical (17.5), then slash (16.8), and it adds 27 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 71, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 50, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: As a full set, Crucible Axe Set adds up to 36.9 weight and 58 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 15.5 weight and want more physical negation.
name: Crucible Axe Armor

desc: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.
location: Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.
whatItIs: Crucible Tree Armor is a chest piece from Crucible Tree Set weighing 15.5. This piece can be altered. A chest in Deeproot Depths holds it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (17.7), then slash (17.5), with 27 poise on top. For status effects, robustness (71) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (50) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Crucible Tree Set, the full set totals 36.9 weight and 58 poise. Budget 15.5 weight for the chest slot.
name: Crucible Tree Armor

desc: Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn. The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.
whatItIs: Radahn's Lion Armor is a chest piece from Radahn's Set weighing 17.5. This piece can be altered. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: It gives 28 poise, and its best negation is against physical (18.7), then slash (18.3). For status effects, robustness (99) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (60) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Radahn's Set, the full set totals 41.6 weight and 60 poise. At 17.5 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Radahn's Lion Armor

desc: Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted. When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.
location: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Lionel's Set includes Lionel's Armor as its chest piece, weight 21.2. An altered form of this piece exists. Corpse loot in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against pierce (19.7), then slash (19.2), with 37 poise on top. For status effects, robustness (99) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (63) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: The complete Lionel's Set comes to 50.5 weight and 79 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 21.2 weight and want more pierce negation.
name: Lionel's Armor

desc: Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off. Worn by the Dung Eater. The heavy, sun-shaped medallion represents both the guidance he once saw, and the ring to which it will one day lead.
location: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.
whatItIs: Omen Armor is a chest piece from Omen Set weighing 23.1.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash and pierce (18.7 each), with 40 poise on top. For status effects, vitality (76) leads, helping against death blight, followed by immunity (67) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Omen Set, the full set totals 55 weight and 86 poise. At 23.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Omen Armor

desc: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks. The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."
location: Dropped by Fire Prelates.
whatItIs: Fire Prelate Armor is a chest piece from Fire Prelate Set weighing 24.7. An altered form of this piece exists. Look for it as a drop from Fire Prelates.
whyItMatters: It gives 40 poise, and its best negation is against fire (19.8), then physical (19.2). The focus value of 90 helps against sleep and madness, and the immunity value of 67 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Fire Prelate Set, the full set totals 58.8 weight and 87 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 24.7 weight and want more fire negation.
name: Fire Prelate Armor

desc: Light yet sturdy leather manchettes. Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.
location: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.
whatItIs: Traveler's Manchettes is a arm piece from Traveler's Set weighing 1.7. The location note is on its record.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic (3.3), then fire (3.2), with 1 poise on top. For status effects, focus (25) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (25) against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Traveler's Set, the full set totals 8.9 weight and 4 poise. Budget 1.7 weight for the arms slot.
name: Traveler's Manchettes

desc: Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees. In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.
location: 1.5% chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it.
whatItIs: Guardian Bracers is a arm piece weighing 2.9. It drops from Erdtree Guardian (a 1.5% chance).
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and lightning (2.9 each), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, immunity (25) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by focus (20) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Check your equip load before adding its 2.9 weight to the arms slot.
name: Guardian Bracers

desc: Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.
location: Found on a corpse near the Underground Roadsite site of grace located in the sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Bloodsoaked Manchettes is a arm piece from Bloodsoaked Set weighing 1.4. Corpse loot at Underground Roadsite.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic and fire (3.1 each), with 0 poise on top. The focus value of 24 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 22 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Bloodsoaked Set, the full set totals 7.7 weight and 1 poise. Budget 1.4 weight for the arms slot.
name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes

desc: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the arms. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.
location: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Mushroom Arms is a arm piece, weight 1.7. A corpse in Mt. Gelmir carries it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (3.3), then lightning (3.2), and it adds 0 poise. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 34, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 30, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 1.7 weight for the arms slot.
name: Mushroom Arms

desc: Gloves fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
location: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).
whatItIs: Astrologer Gloves is a arm piece from Astrologer Set weighing 1.4. It is Astrologer starting gear.
whyItMatters: It gives 1 poise, and its best negation is against magic and lightning (3.2 each). The focus value of 24 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 21 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: The complete Astrologer Set comes to 13.3 weight and 10 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 1.4 weight for the arms slot.
name: Astrologer Gloves

desc: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.
location: 1.5% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.
whatItIs: Sorcerer Manchettes is a arm piece from Lazuli Sorcerer Set weighing 1.1. Dropped by Glintstone Sorcerer (a 1.5% chance).
whyItMatters: It gives 0 poise, and its best negation is against magic (3.2), then fire (3.1). The focus value of 21 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 20 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Lazuli Sorcerer Set, the full set totals 12.3 weight and 6 poise. Budget 1.1 weight for the arms slot.
name: Sorcerer Manchettes

desc: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefied.
location: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.
whatItIs: Battlemage Manchettes is the arms slot of Battlemage Set, at 1.1 weight. An enemy drop in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: It gives 0 poise, and its best negation is against magic (3.2), then holy (3.1). For status effects, vitality (22) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (20) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Battlemage Set, the full set totals 10.4 weight and 10 poise. At 1.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Battlemage Manchettes

desc: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.
location: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes is a arm piece from Errant Sorcerer Set weighing 1.1. Looted from a corpse in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against magic and holy (3.2 each), with 0 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are vitality at 22, which helps against death blight, and focus at 21, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Worn with the rest of Errant Sorcerer Set, the full set totals 11.3 weight and 5 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 1.1 weight and want more magic negation.
name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes

desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills. Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.
location: Drops from Rogier.
whatItIs: Spellblade's Gloves is a arm piece from Spellblade's Set weighing 1.2. Dropped by Rogier.
whyItMatters: It gives 0 poise, and its best negation is against magic and holy (3.1 each). For status effects, vitality (20) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (19) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Spellblade's Set comes to 8.6 weight and 2 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 1.2 weight for the arms slot.
name: Spellblade's Gloves

desc: Mad Tongue Alberich's bracers. Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthen thorn sorcery. Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.
location: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Alberich's Set includes Alberich's Bracers as its arm piece, weight 1.4. Look for it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic and holy (3.2 each), and it adds 0 poise. For status effects, vitality (24) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (22) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: As a full set, Alberich's Set adds up to 9.7 weight and 8 poise. Budget 1.4 weight for the arms slot.
name: Alberich's Bracers

desc: Gloves of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.
location: Found after advancing Ranni's questline until Seluvis dies, inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Preceptor's Gloves is the arms slot piece, at 2.1 weight. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (3.6), then fire (3.3), and it adds 1 poise. For status effects, focus (28) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (25) against death blight.
whenToUse: At 2.1 weight it is worth slotting in whenever magic negation is what you are short on.
name: Preceptor's Gloves

desc: Manchettes corroded by blue-green glintstones. Worn by Azur, primeval current sorcerer. Azur had reached a near-inorganic state.
location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.
whatItIs: Azur's Manchettes is a arm piece from Azur's Glintstone Set weighing 1.1. Mt. Gelmir is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It gives 0 poise, and its best negation is against magic (3.4), then holy (3.2). The focus value of 22 helps against sleep and madness, and the vitality value of 20 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Azur's Glintstone Set adds up to 14.3 weight and 6 poise. Budget 1.1 weight for the arms slot.
name: Azur's Manchettes

desc: Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer. Lusat had reached a near-inorganic state.
location: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.
whatItIs: Lusat's Manchettes is the arms slot of Lusat's Set, at 1.1 weight. Its record carries a location note.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (3.4), then lightning (3.1), and it adds 0 poise. The vitality value of 22 helps against death blight, and the focus value of 20 helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Lusat's Set comes to 14.3 weight and 6 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 1.1 weight for the arms slot.
name: Lusat's Manchettes

desc: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.
location: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
whatItIs: Queen's Set includes Queen's Bracelets as its arm piece, weight 1.7. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.
whyItMatters: It gives 0 poise, and its best negation is against magic (3.4), then holy (3.3). For status effects, vitality (28) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (24) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: The complete Queen's Set comes to 11 weight and 4 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 1.7 weight to the arms slot.
name: Queen's Bracelets

desc: Gloves worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.
location: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Traveling Maiden Gloves is a arm piece weighing 1.6. Corpse loot at Shack of the Lofty.
whyItMatters: It gives 1 poise, and its best negation is against magic and holy (3.3 each). For status effects, vitality (28) leads, helping against death blight, followed by focus (25) against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Budget 1.6 weight for the arms slot.
name: Traveling Maiden Gloves

desc: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made by Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.
location: Finish Goldmask's questline.
whatItIs: Goldmask's Set includes Gold Bracelets as its arm piece, weight 0.8.
whyItMatters: It gives 1 poise, and its best negation is against holy (3.2), then magic (2.9). For status effects, focus (20) leads, helping against sleep and madness, followed by vitality (20) against death blight.
whenToUse: As a full set, Goldmask's Set adds up to 9.8 weight and 10 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 0.8 weight to the arms slot.

Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.
location: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Swordstress enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered) is the chest slot piece, at 7.5 weight. It is the altered version of Nox Swordstress Armor. Enemies drop it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against magic (12.4), then lightning (11.9), and it adds 5 poise. Its two highest resistances are immunity at 56, which helps against poison and scarlet rot, and focus at 49, which helps against sleep and madness.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 7.5 weight and want more magic negation.
name: Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.
location: Starting gear for the Samurai class (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.
whatItIs: Land of Reeds Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Land of Reeds Set, at 7.8 weight. It is the altered version of Land of Reeds Armor. It is Samurai starting gear.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash and lightning (11.4 each), and it adds 4 poise. The immunity value of 52 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the vitality value of 45 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: In practice, the complete Land of Reeds Set comes to 19.8 weight and 13 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 7.8 weight to the chest slot.
name: Land of Reeds Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn. The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.
location: Dropped by Yura (unaltered) only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Ronin's Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Ronin's Set, at 7.6 weight. This is Ronin's Armor in its altered form. Yura can drop it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against lightning (11.9), then fire (10.9), with 4 poise on top. The immunity value of 54 helps against poison and scarlet rot, and the vitality value of 45 helps against death blight.
whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, Ronin's Set adds up to 21.1 weight and 15 poise. At 7.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever lightning negation is what you are short on.
name: Ronin's Armor (Altered)

desc: Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers. Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.
location: Chance to drop unaltered from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered) is the chest slot piece, at 8.5 weight. It is the altered version of Blue Silver Mail Armor. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (12.6), then physical (12.1), and it adds 10 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 52, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 21, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 8.5 weight and want more slash negation.
name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.
location: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield. The chest piece can then be altered at a site of grace or with the help of Boc.
whatItIs: Black Knife Armor (Altered) is a chest piece from Black Knife Set weighing 9. This is Black Knife Armor in its altered form. Found in a chest in Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash and pierce (12.3 each), with 12 poise on top. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 42, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 25, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, Black Knife Set adds up to 21.8 weight and 29 poise. At 9 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Black Knife Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."
location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Malenia's Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Malenia's Set, at 6.8 weight. This is Malenia's Armor in its altered form. Located in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: It gives 7 poise, and its best negation is against slash (10.7), then physical (10). For status effects, immunity (29) leads, helping against poison and scarlet rot, followed by robustness (25) against blood loss and frostbite.
whenToUse: In practice, the complete Malenia's Set comes to 20.5 weight and 24 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Budget 6.8 weight for the chest slot.
name: Malenia's Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.
location: Gotten from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.
whatItIs: Elden Lord Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Elden Lord Set. This is Elden Lord Armor in its altered form. Beat Godfrey, First Elden Lord for it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against pierce (12.4), then slash (11.4), with 14 poise on top. For a new player, the robustness value of 55 helps against blood loss and frostbite, and the immunity value of 32 helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, the complete Elden Lord Set comes to 21.4 weight and 27 poise, so plan your equip load around that.
name: Elden Lord Armor (Altered)

desc: Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. The crest emblazoned on the front is worn and dingy, no longer able to evoke sentiment. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.
location: Starting gear for the Vagabond class (unaltered). Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants) Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

whyItMatters: Negation peaks against physical (13.2), then slash (12.2), with 12 poise on top. For status effects, robustness (50) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (29) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, Vagabond Knight Set adds up to 23.8 weight and 30 poise. At 9.6 weight it is worth slotting in whenever physical negation is what you are short on.
name: Vagabond Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.
location: Can be found unaltered in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Carian Knight Set, the full set totals 25.1 weight and 26 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 9.7 weight and want more slash negation.
name: Carian Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the golden lineage. The knights surely boasted of their strength in days long gone.
location: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies. Can be altered by Boc.
whatItIs: Godrick Knight Armor (Altered) is a chest piece from Godrick Knight Set weighing 10.8. This is Godrick Knight Armor in its altered form. Dropped by Godrick Knight.

name: Godrick Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its left breast is emblazoned with a peering cuckoo, whence came their name. Perhaps the bird's shrewd gaze is an expression of their refusal to be mere servants of the academy.
location: Chance to drop unaltered from Cuckoo Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

desc: Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve. "Alas, dear home, I shan't see you again! For our duty is to remain here, a bulwark against the blight."

name: Redmane Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from lofty ambition into gluttonous depravity. As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master.

name: Gelmir Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.
location: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.
whatItIs: Leyndell Knight Set includes Leyndell Knight Armor (Altered) as its chest piece, weight 10.8. It is the altered version of Leyndell Knight Armor. Look for it as a drop from Leyndell Knight in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical and slash (13.1 each), and it adds 17 poise. In practice, its two highest resistances are robustness at 50, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 32, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, Leyndell Knight Set adds up to 28.1 weight and 40 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 10.8 weight to the chest slot.
name: Leyndell Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.
location: Chance to drop unaltered from Haligtree Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Haligtree Knight Set includes Haligtree Knight Armor (Altered) as its chest piece, weight 10.8. This is Haligtree Knight Armor in its altered form. Enemies drop it.

name: Haligtree Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. The wing-shaped ornament on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, Mausoleum Knight Set adds up to 23 weight and 37 poise. At 10.8 weight it is worth slotting in whenever slash negation is what you are short on.
name: Mausoleum Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Metal armor with a jutting breastplate. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.
location: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.
whatItIs: Bloodhound Knight Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Bloodhound Knight Set, at 9.6 weight. It is the altered version of Bloodhound Knight Armor. It drops from Bloodhound Knight.
whyItMatters: It gives 12 poise, and its best negation is against slash (13.7), then pierce (13.2). For status effects, robustness (45) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (29) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, the complete Bloodhound Knight Set comes to 25.3 weight and 29 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Check your equip load before adding its 9.6 weight to the chest slot.
name: Bloodhound Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.
location: Chance to drop unaltered from Cleanrot Knight enemies. It can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Cleanrot Armor (Altered) is a chest piece from Cleanrot Set weighing 13.7. This is Cleanrot Armor in its altered form. An enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It gives 24 poise, and its best negation is against pierce (16), then slash (14.6). Its two highest resistances are robustness at 54, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 52, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Cleanrot Set, the full set totals 35.7 weight and 58 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 13.7 weight and want more pierce negation.
name: Cleanrot Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.
location: Defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf and modify with Boc.
whatItIs: Raging Wolf Set includes Raging Wolf Armor (Altered) as its chest piece. This is Raging Wolf Armor in its altered form. Beat Vargram the Raging Wolf to get it.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against slash (13.5), then pierce (12.9), and it adds 15 poise. For status effects, robustness (57) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (32) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Raging Wolf Set, the full set totals 25.3 weight and 32 poise.
name: Raging Wolf Armor (Altered)

desc: Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family. When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused. "I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."
location: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants. Altered by Boc.
whatItIs: Hoslow's Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Hoslow's Set, at 10.8 weight. It is the altered version of Hoslow's Armor. Located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Its damage negation is strongest against physical (13.6), then slash (13.5), and it adds 16 poise. Its two highest resistances are robustness at 60, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 38, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Hoslow's Set, the full set totals 28.5 weight and 36 poise. Budget 10.8 weight for the chest slot.
name: Hoslow's Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver. The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another. Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.
location: Dropped unaltered upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Twinned Set includes Twinned Armor (Altered) as its chest piece, weight 12.8. This is Twinned Armor in its altered form. In practice, beat D, Hunter of the Dead for it.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against slash (15.3), then physical (14), with 17 poise on top. For status effects, robustness (52) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by vitality (52) against death blight.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Twinned Set, the full set totals 30 weight and 40 poise. Budget 12.8 weight for the chest slot.
name: Twinned Armor (Altered)

desc: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.
location: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Drake Knight Set includes Drake Knight Armor (Altered) as its chest piece, weight 8.3. It is the altered version of Drake Knight Armor. Chest loot in Crumbling Farum Azula.
whyItMatters: It gives 8 poise, and its best negation is against physical and slash (11.2 each). For status effects, robustness (34) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (21) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Drake Knight Set, the full set totals 22 weight and 29 poise. Slot it in when you can spare 8.3 weight and want more physical negation.
name: Drake Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd. Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.
location: Received unaltered after killing Blaidd at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Blaidd's Armor (Altered) is a chest piece, weight 12.5. It is the altered version of Blaidd's Armor. Blaidd has to fall first before you get this piece.
whyItMatters: Negation peaks against pierce (14.6), then physical (14), with 20 poise on top. In practice, for status effects, robustness (57) leads, helping against blood loss and frostbite, followed by immunity (32) against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: Slot it in when you can spare 12.5 weight and want more pierce negation.
name: Blaidd's Armor (Altered)

desc: Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar. The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls. Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.
location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes once Elemer of the Briar has been defeated. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
whatItIs: Briar Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of Briar Set, at 10.7 weight. It is the altered version of Briar Armor. A merchant in Roundtable Hold sells it.

whenToUse: In practice, the complete Briar Set comes to 28.1 weight and 31 poise, so plan your equip load around that. Slot it in when you can spare 10.7 weight and want more physical negation.
name: Briar Armor (Altered)

desc: Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?
location: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: Fingerprint Set includes Fingerprint Armor (Altered) as its chest piece, weight 10. It is the altered version of Fingerprint Armor. Beat Roundtable Knight Vyke for it.
whyItMatters: It gives 17 poise, and its best negation is against physical (13.1), then fire (12.2). Its two highest resistances are robustness at 54, which helps against blood loss and frostbite, and immunity at 29, which helps against poison and scarlet rot.
whenToUse: In practice, worn with the rest of Fingerprint Set, the full set totals 25.3 weight and 40 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 10 weight to the chest slot.
name: Fingerprint Armor (Altered)

desc: Armor set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.
location: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.
whatItIs: All-Knowing Armor (Altered) is the chest slot of All-Knowing Set, at 9.3 weight. It is the altered version of All-Knowing Armor. Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing has to fall first before you get this piece.

whenToUse: In practice, as a full set, All-Knowing Set adds up to 25.4 weight and 42 poise. Check your equip load before adding its 9.3 weight to the chest slot.
name: All-Knowing Armor (Altered)

location: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

name: Royal Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.
location: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
whatItIs: Maliketh's Set includes Maliketh's Armor (Altered) as its chest piece. It is the altered version of Maliketh's Armor. Sold by Finger Reader Enia.

name: Maliketh's Armor (Altered)

desc: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.
location: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it. Cannot be obtained by altering it yourself.

name: Banished Knight Armor (Altered)

desc: Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.
